description:
Log and manage time entries per thread, billable or not, stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/hours.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION... [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — append an entry
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT...] [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change fields of an entry
  rm ID -y — permanently delete an entry

Args:
  THREAD  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  DESCRIPTION  one or more words; non-empty
  ID  8-char entry id from hours list

Flags:
  log:
    -m, --minutes N  duration; default 60; must be positive
    -r, --rate N  hourly rate; 0 = unbillable; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE  ISO code; default the thread's currency; with neither, the entry is recorded unbilled
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD  default today
    -t, --time HH:MM  start time; default now
  edit:
    --description TEXT...  new description; consumes all following words
    -m, --minutes N  new duration; start unchanged
    -r, --rate N  new rate; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE  new ISO code
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD  move to this day; duration kept
    -t, --time HH:MM  move start time; duration kept
  list, report, show:
    --since / --until YYYY-MM-DD; --json
  rm:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "DORA metric validation", "-m", "180"]
  ["log", "Topics/Fitness", "5k run", "-m", "30", "-d", "2026-10-06"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-10-01", "--json"]
  ["edit", "1a2b3c4d", "-m", "90"]

Notes:
  DESCRIPTION is a short invoice line item. Put narrative in a log line (buffer add-text); hours descriptions are not searchable.
  log also queues a REF: in buffer.md, filed into the thread's log for the entry date on buffer flush.
  In edit, put ID first and --description last.
  Exit 1: non-positive minutes, rate without currency, empty description, entry with a rate but no currency.
